mapper.insert: insert into sky_take_out.orders (number, status, user_id, address_book_id, order_time, checkout_time, pay_status, amount, remark, phone, address, user_name, consignee, estimated_delivery_time, delivery_time, pack_amount, tableware_number, tableware_status) values (#{number}, #{status}, #{userId}, #{addressBookId}, #{orderTime}, #{checkoutTime}, #{payStatus}, #{amount}, #{remark}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{userName}, #{consignee}, #{estimatedDeliveryTime}, #{deliveryTime}, #{packAmount}, #{tablewareNumber}, #{tablewareStatus})

insert into sky_take_out.order_detail (name, image, order_id, dish_id, setmeal_id, dish_flavor, number, amount) values
(#{detail.name}, #{detail.image}, #{detail.orderId}, #{detail.dishId}, #{detail.setmealId}, #{detail.dishFlavor}, #{detail.number}, #{detail.amount})
